description: The user's history for one tool, newest first, filtered by date: video_to_srt (transcriptions: job_id, SRT preview; full SRT with get_transcription), video_localization and voice_to_voice (job_guid, status, final_video_url, audio_url, translated_srt_url), srt_to_speech / multi_voice / text_to_speech (job_id, audio_url), srt_translation (translation_id; full translated SRT with get_srt_translation).
